name: Abhinav Leasing and Finance Limited
about: Abhinav Leasing and Finance Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company finances industrial and trading enterprises, corporations, and individuals through loans and advances. It also provides loans against property/securities. In addition, the company is involved in leasing, hire-purchase, and lending activities; raising of funds through borrowings and securities; third party product distribution; origination of unsecured personal and corporate loans; and investment and treasury activities, which include acquiring, holding, purchasing, selling, and dealing in shares, stocks, securities, debentures, bonds, and other financial instruments. Abhinav Leasing and Finance Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.
